name: portamp
description: A tiny plugin host that ports legacy front ends. Reads Angular, AngularJS, Vue, Knockout, Backbone, jQuery or a running app with no source; recognises what it is; emits React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Lit or a custom element, with the proofs beside them.

scripts.demo: node src/cli.js run --src example/legacy --shots example/screenshots --out example/out
scripts.demo-site: node src/cli.js run --src example/legacy-site --out example/out-site --site true
scripts.demo-portal: node src/cli.js run --src example/legacy-portal --out example/out-portal --site true
